changelog:
Your phone can now send what it is playing to a television.

WHAT CHANGED

- PerchTV: pair this phone with a television running the PerchTV app, then
  long-press a channel, film or episode and choose Send to put it on the
  big screen.
- Pairing uses the six digits shown on the television, or you can scan the
  television's QR code instead. The camera is asked for only when you open
  the scanner, and only for this.
- A pairing lasts until you end it. Settings has a new Television section
  showing the paired set, with an Unpair button. The television's remote
  can end the pairing from its side too.
- Films and single episodes can be sent. A whole-series card cannot, and
  Plex items are not offered, because the television has no way to reach
  them.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else. This release adds the television half. Nothing you
  already use has changed.
